name: Front Calipers
description: Fixed, opposed-piston calipers bolted directly to the front knuckle (no bracket on the factory Brembo installs). ZL1/ZL1 1LE: Brembo 6-piston monobloc (2x38, 2x34, 2x30 mm). Race: AP Racing Radi-CAL (Essex kits) or Wilwood SX6R on radial-mount brackets. Calipers sit behind the axle centerline (trailing) on the Gen 6.

components.name: Front brake caliper
components.description: Clamps the pads onto the front rotor; the front axle does ~65–70% of the braking on this car. The factory ZL1 6-piston Brembo is strong but on a full race car its piston dust boots cook after hard sessions (Essex customer report) and fluid temps run high; race calipers without boots, with stiffer bodies and thicker 25 mm pads are the usual upgrade.
components.location: Front knuckle, trailing side of the rotor (behind the axle centerline), outboard of the strut lower mount. Approx center x≈+0.165, y≈0.37, z≈±0.70.

factory.name: Brembo 6-piston monobloc, ZL1 / ZL1 1LE (RPO J6G package)
factory.notes: Cast aluminum fixed caliper; pistons 2x38, 2x34, 2x30 mm. ZL1 1LE TSB lists 6-piston fixed cast-aluminum front with 390x36 mm rotor. SS (J55): Brembo 4-piston fixed front. SS 1LE: Brembo front with 370 mm (14.6 in) two-piece rotors (Wikipedia lists 6-piston – verify on your car). Base cars (JL9): single-piston floating caliper on a bracket.

raceOptions.name: AP Racing by Essex Radi-CAL Competition kit, CP9660 + 372x34 mm
raceOptions.notes: Fits behind OEM 1LE 20 in wheels; saves ~22 lb unsprung vs OEM 1LE; pistons sized for OEM master/ABS; Essex recommends 390 mm kits for forced-induction cars like ZL1.

raceOptions.name: AP Racing by Essex Radi-CAL ENP Competition kit, CP9668 + 372x34 mm
raceOptions.notes: ENP finish; ~20 lb saved vs SS 1LE brakes. CP9668 takes FRP3014-shape pads, 25 mm thick.

raceOptions.name: AP Racing by Essex CP9668 Heavy Duty kit, 390 mm
raceOptions.notes: Uses D62 (62 mm tall) pads for more pad volume – preferred for a heavy, high-power road-race Camaro.

raceOptions.name: Wilwood SX6R front kit, 2016–2019 Camaro
raceOptions.notes: Forged 6-piston with SS pistons; 14 or 15 in GT/SRP rotors or 15 in WCCB carbon-ceramic; brackets, hardware, stainless flexlines.

raceOptions.name: GM Accessories Brembo 6-piston front package (for LT/SS w/o 1LE)
raceOptions.notes: 370x34 mm two-piece rotors, low-expansion hoses, hardware.

raceOptions.name: Brembo GT-R / Alcon / StopTech race kits
raceOptions.notes: Available for Gen 6 Camaro; confirm wheel clearance for 18 in race wheels.

hardware.spec: Large flange bolt into knuckle (M14x1.5 typical – verify size)
hardware.torqueSequence: First pass 150 N·m (111 lb ft), then final pass +15–30°. Owners quoting the SI say GM does not list these as single-use bolts.
hardware.reuse: Replace (GM procedure calls for new bolts; TTY status disputed)
hardware.tool: 21 mm or 18 mm socket (verify), angle gauge
hardware.notes: GM 2016–18 table: "Front brake caliper bolt 150 N·m, J55, J6G – First pass". Final angle 15–30° from owners quoting the service manual. Do NOT use the 60 N·m+90° / 40 N·m+90° values seen online – those are for base-car (JL9) caliper brackets. [2026-10 check] The final angle is now filled in. A camaro6.com owner quotes the GM SI (2019 SS Brembo) as 150 N·m + 15–30°. TightTorque (GM 2016–18 SI) gives 150 N·m first pass for J55/J6G, and an ATS (Alpha) owner quotes 150 N·m + 30°. No GM primary document was found.

hardware.spec: M8/M10 bleeder screw with dust cap
Use the OEM caliper bolt holes; bolts supplied/specified by kit maker
hardware.torque: Per kit instructions (if kit says OEM: 150 N·m + 15–30°)

hardware.spec: M12 radial-mount bolts with shims as required for centering
hardware.torque: Per kit instructions (typical M12 12.9 in steel ≈ 80–90 N·m / 59–66 ft-lb)
hardware.notes: Center caliper over the disc with shims so pads sit square; check with feeler gauges both sides.

installNotes: Install hub bearing, dust shield/duct backing plate and rotor first.
Clean knuckle threads; apply blue threadlocker to new bolts; torque 150 N·m then turn +15–30°.
Confirm caliper orientation: bleeders must be at the TOP (left and right calipers are handed – swapping sides puts bleeders at the bottom and you cannot bleed air out).
Fit pads, pins, spring and cross bolt; connect hose with new crush washers.
Spin the hub: rotor must not touch the caliper bridge; check radial clearance to the wheel spokes with the race wheel (≥ 3 mm).
inspection: Every session: look for fluid at pistons/boots and bleeders; check pad thickness through the caliper window.
Every event: check caliper bolt torque marks; inspect dust boots (factory) for heat damage; temperature paint on the caliper body (aim < ~200 °C caliper body).
Every season: rebuild seals (factory kit: 2x30/34/38 mm seals and boots per caliper).

components.name: Front pad retaining pins, anti-rattle spring & cross bolt
components.description: Factory Brembo: two pressed pins through the caliper and pads (tapped out with a small punch) plus a spring plate held by a center cross bolt. Race AP calipers use two bolt-in pad retaining pins with anti-rattle clips, or a quick-change spring clip. GM/B&FE: always replace pins and anti-rattle clips with new pads.
components.location: Across the caliper window above the pads, each front caliper.

factory.name: Brembo pad pin & spring kit (comes with GM pads/hardware kit)
factory.notes: Pins are drift-punched out; leave caliper on the car for pad changes.

raceOptions.name: AP Racing pad retaining bolts / quick-change spring retainer
raceOptions.notes: Essex customer replaced two 6 mm retaining bolts with a quick-change spring clip (≈ 5 min/side pad change).

hardware.torque: ≈ 14 ft-lb (19 N·m) owner-reported; an owner-posted GM chart was read as 9 N·m front / 10 N·m rear
hardware.notes: Conflicting forum values – snug, do not overtighten into aluminum. Verify in GM SI.

hardware.torque: Factory: drift in until flush; AP bolt-in: per AP (light, ≈ 3–5 N·m)

installNotes: Lightly coat pad backing-plate ears (left/right edges) with brake lube/anti-seize, not the friction face.
Drive pins in from the correct side so the spring loads the pads.
inspection: Check pins are fully seated and clips present before every session.

components.name: Front caliper piston seals & dust boots (service kit)
components.description: Square-section piston seals and dust boots for rebuilding the factory 6-piston Brembos. On race cars the boots are often removed after heat damage (or race calipers without boots are used).

factory.name: Brembo seal kit for ZL1 / ZL1 1LE front caliper

raceOptions.name: PMB Performance front seal kit (2x30, 2x34, 2x38 mm per caliper)

installNotes: Rebuild on the bench with fresh brake fluid as assembly lube; never use petroleum grease.
inspection: Rebuild annually or when boots are brittle/torn.
